minutes.headline: Board appointed a Parks Commissioner and ZBA members, and put off Keating earth removal renewals to August.
minutes.summary: The board held license hearings, filled a Parks Commission seat and Zoning Board seats, and heard the building commissioner on earth removal permits. Keating's renewals were deferred to a later August meeting, and one Powell closure plan was approved. The town manager reported on the state budget, the skateboard park and ADA planning.

public_comment.topic: A resident presented a citizen's petition to ban plastic bags.
Stillman's Fair organizers and the school nurse asked support for a William James College mental health referral service for the whole town.

what_happened.line: The Select Board deferred the Keating earth removal renewals to a later August meeting, pending review by the building commissioner and town counsel.
The board appointed Susanna Jewell as Parks Commissioner by roll call; a second candidate had also been nominated.
The board approved the closure plan for earth removal permit 54 as submitted.
The board approved three license items at hearings, and extended the Bootleggers license to October 31st.
The town manager reported on the state budget, which included asbestos abatement money for Turkey Hill that can free up capital funds.

why_it_matters: Earth removal permits govern gravel and soil operations in town, so the deferral leaves Keating's renewals unsettled until the board acts and the review is done.
State money for asbestos abatement at Turkey Hill can free up capital funds, which bears on what the town must raise or borrow for other projects.
watch_next: A future August meeting for the Keating earth removal renewals, after building commissioner and town counsel review.
The August 21 meeting, set for selection policy items, after next week's earth removal workshop.
